why: NAWEC's operating officer gave a range of two to six blackouts a month; the drafter took the midpoint, which the source does not state. The top of the range is taken.
The survey's country profile prints 0.9 for the 2024 survey whose held series figure is 1.02; the series figure stands and the rounded print is not a second figure.

Stage 4c 2026-11-06: the Director-General of Energy gives EAGB interruptions per day (0.9 in 2025), not per customer a year; the drafter's 27 a month is a conversion the source does not state and the aspect does not admit.
